note: Source assertions preserved; task links are candidates, not test results. All mandatory scenarios have final verification in T-11-01. Supplemental gates are separate from 218 source scenarios.

cases.assertion: Create and export a flowchart with at least one decision and two labeled branches.
Create and export an IT architecture diagram with at least ten components, a system boundary and status labels.
Move and resize connected nodes without losing valid connections. Delete a node without leaving orphaned edges.
Undo and redo representative node, edge, grouping and styling operations.
Reload after a successful autosave and recover diagram content and layout.
Export JSON, import it as a separate document, and verify equivalent graph content and styling. Invalid JSON must not corrupt existing diagrams.
Export PNG and SVG and verify complete, readable content, including nested groups and connector labels, with no editor controls.
Pass essential keyboard, browser compatibility and reference-diagram performance tests defined in DGS-10.
Given an empty library, create two diagrams; both appear and open independently.
Rename to a valid title, reload and confirm persistence; reject blank titles without losing the previous title.
Duplicate a connected, grouped diagram, edit the copy and verify original graph and styling are unchanged.
Cancel deletion then confirm it; verify the document survives cancellation and is absent after confirmed deletion and reload.
Simulate a failed save during document switching; verify a warning and preservation of the in-memory edits.
Pan and zoom a populated canvas; verify node coordinates and graph remain unchanged.
Drop the same component at a target under two viewport transforms; placement matches the pointer in world space.
Fit a diagram spanning negative and positive coordinates; all bounds are visible when achievable within the supported zoom range. Fit on an empty canvas must not fail.
Insert, select, drag and resize a node; verify identity and connected endpoints are preserved.
Select two connected nodes, move them together, and verify their relative layout and edge.
Duplicate two connected nodes where one also connects outside the selection; verify only their internal edge is copied.
Delete a connected node and confirm no orphaned edges or group memberships remain. Undo restores the graph.
Insert at least one of every mandatory component type; verify labels, selection and supported handles.
Use a process, decision, server and database in one document; save/reopen and verify types are preserved.
Open the loaded editor with network disconnected and verify built-in components remain available without remote assets.
Edit a multiline label, change fill/border/font/alignment, save and reopen; verify values survive.
Enter invalid numeric and color values; verify validation and preservation of previous state.
Enter text resembling HTML or a script; verify it renders as inert text in the editor and export.
Apply a shared fill to multiple compatible shapes; verify unselected shapes are unchanged and undo reverses the operation.
Connect three nodes with two branches; move and resize them, and verify all endpoints stay attached.
Attempt a self-loop, exact duplicate and invalid target; no invalid edge or history entry is created.
Create a cycle using distinct nodes; verify valid graph relationships survive save/reopen.
Delete one edge from a branched graph; other edges and nodes remain unchanged.
Switch a labeled edge between straight and orthogonal routes; verify style, label and endpoint identity.
Reconnect an edge successfully and then attempt an invalid reconnection; verify the last valid edge is retained.
Export edges with different arrowhead styles, labels and dashed lines; verify visible fidelity.
Create a titled boundary containing two nodes; move the boundary and verify each child moves once and cross-boundary edges remain attached.
Nest a boundary, attempt cyclic membership and verify rejection without document mutation.
Reparent a node and ungroup a boundary; verify absolute position and graph relationships are unchanged.
Shrink below child content or move a child beyond a boundary; verify the defined containment rule and no hidden children.
Delete a boundary, then undo; verify children survive and original membership is restored.
Assign each status to architecture nodes, reload, duplicate and verify values and labels.
View/export the diagram in grayscale; distinct text labels remain understandable without color.
Reset a status and undo; verify the indicator and underlying style are restored.
Move a node via a continuous drag; one undo restores the initial position and one redo restores final position.
Delete a connected grouped node, undo and redo; verify all dependent edges and membership are restored/removed atomically.
Undo an edit then commit a different edit; redo becomes unavailable.
Undo, wait for a successful save and reload; verify the restored document state, with fresh history.
Edit a diagram, wait for saved locally, reload and compare graph, styling and settings.
Simulate a quota/write failure; verify no false saved status, last valid snapshot remains intact and backup export is available.
Rapidly commit several edits while a write is pending; final persisted state corresponds to the latest successful revision.
Open the same document in two tabs and commit conflicting changes; verify the stale tab cannot silently overwrite the newer revision.
Export a styled, nested, connected diagram and import it as a new document; compare equivalent graph and styling, ignoring new identity/timestamps.
Import malformed JSON, unsupported schema, duplicate IDs, dangling edges and cyclic groups; each is rejected with no mutation of existing documents.
Import an oversized file or unsafe asset reference; verify controlled rejection and no execution or unauthorized remote requests.
Export a diagram extending beyond the viewport and into negative coordinates; verify all content is included with padding.
Open PNG and SVG in independent viewers; verify labels, icons, styles, nested boundaries, connectors and statuses are visible and no editor UI appears.
Export while storage is unavailable but the current diagram is valid; verify export succeeds independently of local storage.
Attempt export of empty or unsupported oversized content; verify a controlled message and no misleading success.
Move with snapping enabled and disabled at multiple zoom levels; verify correct world-grid alignment and free placement respectively.
Use required keyboard actions on the canvas and verify the same result as visible controls.
Use Backspace, Ctrl/Cmd+A and undo while editing text; verify the surrounding diagram is not unintentionally mutated.
Create each template; verify all required elements and valid graph references.
Edit one template instance then create another; verify the original template remains unchanged.
Save, reopen, export and import a template instance through the same workflow as a blank diagram.
mini-map navigation changes only viewport
alignment/distribution preserves graph relationships and is reversible
applying a preset updates only intended visual properties
arrange a branched graph and verify graph topology/metadata unchanged
undo restores exact previous positions
failed/unsupported layout leaves original document unchanged
each extra template opens as a valid independent document
standard editing, save and export work on each template
metadata round-trips as inert text
search returns matching components and clearing restores all categories
reusable style applies compatible fields and is undoable
Empty library offers create/import; create, rename, duplicate and delete show correct feedback and independent records
New diagram dialog presents blank and both templates; cancel leaves no record
Open saved document via static query route, reload; invalid ID offers safe return
Pan, zoom, fit and collapse panels; graph geometry unchanged; controls remain usable at desktop sizes
Drag and keyboard-insert components; single/multi selection and resize feedback readable
